messages:
anya: Quick check — planning to canary flip two runtime toggles tomorrow morning (US morning): flash-attention v2 + speculative-decoding opt-in for kv-cache. Need scope + guardrails before I hit the rollout button. 

matt: which flags exactly? and canary audience?

anya: flags: `runtime.kernel.v2.flash_attn=true` and `runtime.kvcache.spec_decoding_v3=opt-in`. Canary: 5% traffic, only on model-family: rw-5b and rw-7b (no 30b+), region eu-1 and us-west-2. Non-dedicated customers excluded.

sasha: Sounds fine. Add automatic rollback if p99 gen latency increases >10% or error rate >3% for 10m window. Also block if any OOMs on GPUs reported.

raj: for telemetry add these metrics: `inference.p99_latency`, `inference.error_rate`, `gpu.oom_count`, `tokens_per_sec`. Make sure alerts post to #eng-oncall and #incidents.

anya: agreed. I'll wire alerts. What about cached-key correctness checks for spec-decoding? we should validate KV-hit ratio and small fuzz tests.

matt: run the KV consistency job on a small prompt set (use quickset/dev-ckpts) and compare tokens for the first 256 positions. Fail the rollout if mismatch >0.1% across samples.

infra-bot: deploy-checker: preflight OK except: canary policy not set in FF service (no audience rules).

anya: ok I'll add audience rule: `audience: { percent: 5, regions: ["eu-1","us-west-2"], model_tag: ["rw-5b","rw-7b"], customer_tier_exclude: ["free","trial"] }` — will push PR in ~15m.

sasha: tag me in the PR. Also add a soft-fail override to disable flash_attn if model version uses old attention kernels (kernel_compat < 2).

raj: reminder: document the exact fallback chain in release notes: flash_attn -> fallback to scalar-attn; spec_decoding -> fallback to legacy decode with KV disabled. Ops should be able to flip feature flag manually.

an ya: (typo) — done. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4823 (contains FF rule + rollout job + telemetry wires).

matt: quick CR left, small nit on the logging format. after that +1 from me.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for 2026-03-18T13:00:00Z (5% traffic) — will monitor alerts.

anya: thanks — will watch dashboards and stand by to cut to 0% if alerts fire. :thumbsup:

sasha: got it, I'll be on-call during the window.

raj: ping me if we see any cross-region deltas, I'll coordinate capacity.

anya: end of thread (will post post-rollout summary).
